label: Only on AGSIST
note: From the elevator boards AGSIST reads.

facts.sentence: On Friday, Nov 6, 1,421 of the 1,824 elevators AGSIST reads with the same delivery month both days posted a higher cash corn bid than Thursday, 12 a lower one; 187 changed their basis, 9 weaker and 178 stronger.
facts.detail: 391 unchanged; median change 1¢ higher. Biggest state move: Iowa, 1¢ higher (384 elevators). 2 outliers left out.
facts.unit: cents per bushel, median change in cash bid
facts.comparison: last posted bid on 2026-11-06 vs 2026-11-05, same board, crop and delivery period
facts.source: AGSIST elevator network, last posted bid per trading day (data/bids-prev)

facts.sentence: On Friday, Nov 6, 1,579 of the 1,599 elevators AGSIST reads with the same delivery month both days posted a higher cash soybean bid than Thursday, 11 a lower one; 248 changed their basis, 89 weaker and 159 stronger.
facts.detail: 9 unchanged; median change 5¢ higher. Biggest state move: Oklahoma, 8½¢ higher (45 elevators).
facts.unit: cents per bushel, median change in cash bid
facts.comparison: last posted bid on 2026-11-06 vs 2026-11-05, same board, crop and delivery period
facts.source: AGSIST elevator network, last posted bid per trading day (data/bids-prev)

facts.sentence: Corn basis on Nov 7 ran from 55¢ over December futures in Texas to 90¢ under in North Dakota, state medians of the elevators AGSIST read at 4:18 a.m. CT.
facts.detail: Median of 17 elevators in Texas, 49 in North Dakota. 15 states with 15 or more. USDA's North Dakota average on Nov 6: 88 under Dec (USDA AMS, North Dakota Daily Grain Bids, Nov 6, 2026).
facts.unit: cents per bushel between the strongest and weakest state median
facts.comparison: state median basis against ZCZ26, states with 15+ elevators
facts.source: AGSIST elevator network, state median basis (scripts/basis_method.py, data/basis-states.json)

facts.sentence: Of 1,830 elevators AGSIST reads with a fresh corn bid on Nov 7, 172 were paying over futures, most of them in Kansas (34).
facts.detail: 1,629 under futures, 29 even. Each board against the futures month it names.
facts.comparison: basis now on each board's nearest open delivery, boards posted within 36 hours
facts.source: AGSIST elevator network, live board basis (merged-index.json)

facts.sentence: Soybean basis on Nov 7 ran from 24¢ under January futures in Missouri to 95¢ under in North Dakota and Wisconsin, state medians of the elevators AGSIST read at 4:18 a.m. CT.
facts.detail: Median of 24 elevators in Missouri, 62 in North Dakota, 76 in Wisconsin. 13 states with 15 or more. USDA's Missouri average on Nov 6: 52 under Jan (USDA AMS, Missouri Daily Grain Bids, Nov 6, 2026). USDA's North Dakota average on Nov 6: 91 under Jan (USDA AMS, North Dakota Daily Grain Bids, Nov 6, 2026).
